name: Vein Rail

do.objective: Ride to the hub: south to west to the pier on the north side of the ring
The west station. Stay on the rail: the hub is the next stop
The hub relay is thrown. The exit is at the east station: ride there

intro.title: VEIN RAIL
lines: A rail round a drop, and two cars that never stop going round.
The island in the middle is the hub. The only way onto it is the car.

outro: The exit station is dark behind you. The rail runs on without a rider, round the drop, and the cars wait eight seconds at every stop, as if somebody were still getting on.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A rail goes round a drop and the cars go round the rail. In the middle of it there's an island with a copper stack on it and a lamp, and no bridge.

messages.speaker: MANIFEST PLATE
messages.text: CARS: 2. VOICES BORNE PER RUN: 31. RUNS TO THE HUB: 1 IN 4. The last line is a tally of runs, one stroke each. It does not stop at the edge of the plate.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: A car stops at each station for eight seconds. The rim of the deck blinks for the last two. The car stops where the rail stops.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The hub is the third stop after this one. The relay is a lever on the south face of the copper stack, under two lamps.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The west station is a cutting with a ledge on each side. There are singers on the ledges. They are facing the rail.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The pier is the only way off the car at the hub. The island has its own guard. The relay is on the south face of the copper stack.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The relay is thrown. The east station is the last stop before this one: the exit there has come unlocked.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The exit is locked. The hub relay opens it, on the island in the middle of the ring.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The west wall of the west station rings hollow in one place. A line in the paint where a door has been.

messages.speaker: A SILENT (NOTE)
messages.text: I rode this rail for a year with my hands over my ears. If you can read this, take the cases and do not wait for the second car.

objective: Ride to the hub: the relay is on the island in the middle of the ring. A car stops at every station for eight seconds and the rim blinks before it leaves

quality.reason: the place is a rail ring round a drop: the player rides a deck over open air, so the fights are in the open and at the docks
quality.introduces: carriers: a deck on a clock that carries what stands on it, the only floor over the drop
